name: drone_get_capabilities
description: Read execution mode, profile/site revision, registered destinations and exact supported ordered sequences. Does not plan a route.

name: drone_get_status
description: Read mission occupancy and current physical status evidence with explicit unknown values.

name: drone_execute_route
description: Request one mission using an externally selected exact supported ordered sequence. Acceptance is not physical completion; never invent a new request ID to retry an uncertain write.

name: drone_get_mission
description: Read the original mission status, ordered visits and arrival/capture evidence.

name: drone_stop_mission
description: Request mission cancellation. stop_requested is not physical stop or landing confirmation.

name: drone_get_sensor_snapshot
description: Read raw range and health observations; missing or unresolved range values are not free space or object classifications.

name: drone_get_captures
description: Read captures attributed to the mission and ordered visit. Live captures must contain actual image bytes; mock captures are explicitly simulated or absent.
